summary: Completed testing of Patient Health Dashboard feature. All 4 backend endpoints working correctly (11/11 tests passed). Frontend Health Dashboard page loads correctly with all components. Navigation from Home page and Profile page working.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: Missing 'timedelta' import in /app/backend/routes/health_records.py - was causing blood sugar trends endpoint to fail
Fixed: Security issue - password_hash was being exposed in health summary response. Added exclusion in MongoDB query
Backend: All health records endpoints correctly exclude sensitive user data (_id, password, password_hash)
Backend: Health summary endpoint returns comprehensive stats (appointments, diagnostics, pharmacy, blood sugar readings, period logs)
Backend: Timeline endpoint correctly aggregates appointments, diagnostics, and pharmacy orders chronologically
Backend: Blood sugar trends endpoint provides insights based on FBS/PPBS/HbA1c values
Frontend: Health Dashboard requires authentication (redirects to home if not logged in)
Frontend: Dashboard shows patient info card with name, phone, member since date, and health score
Frontend: 4 stat cards (Appointments, Lab Tests, Pharmacy, Health Readings) are clickable and navigate to respective tabs
Frontend: 5 tabs (Overview, Visits, Lab Tests, Medicines, Trends) all present and functional
Frontend: Overview tab shows Recent Activity timeline and Health Insights section
Frontend: Profile page has 'View Complete Health Dashboard' button with correct data-testid
seed_data_creation: Created test user for Health Dashboard testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Health Dashboard feature fully tested. Backend endpoints: GET /api/health-records/summary/{user_id}, GET /api/health-records/timeline/{user_id}, GET /api/health-records/trends/blood-sugar/{user_id}, GET /api/health-records/family/{user_id}. Frontend: /health-dashboard page requires auth, accessible from Home page (More Features > Health Dashboard) and Profile page (View Complete Health Dashboard button). Dashboard shows patient info, 4 stat cards, 5 tabs (Overview, Visits, Lab Tests, Medicines, Trends).

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Missing 'timedelta' import causing blood sugar trends endpoint to fail
password_hash exposed in health summary response (security vulnerability)
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Added 'password_hash': 0 to MongoDB projection in get_health_summary
